claims.quote: Schistura callichromus is a nemacheilid loach recorded only from the Babianjiang River in the Red River basin, Yunnan Province, China.

regions.quote: Schistura callichromus is a nemacheilid loach recorded only from the Babianjiang River in the Red River basin, Yunnan Province, China.

regions.name: Lixianjiang
regions.quote: The Babianjiang joins the Mengyejiang River to form the Langmajiang River, a tributary of the Lixianjiang (Black River) within the Red River basin.

regions.name: Mengyejiang River
regions.quote: At one locality in the Mengyejiang River S. callichromus was collected from a 40 m wide riffle section flowing over rocks and pebbles.
